1408 (Ni-Cr-W alloy) was covered with Cr-rich oxide on the surface (fig. 4). Some Ti was also recognized in the oxide. The film was rather thick and porous, and seemed tightly attached to the matrix.
Beneath the film, internal oxidation of Ti was observed. Also, W-rich precipitates were observed at the interface between the oxide film and the matrix.

1408 (Ni-Cr-W alloy) was covered with Cr-rich oxide on the surface (fig. 4). Some Ti was also recognized in the oxide. The film was rather thick and porous, and seemed tightly attached to the matrix.
The same trend was also observed in another Ni-Cr-W alloy, 113MA (fig. 5). In this alloy, however, the oxide film was thinner than that of 1408, and there were fewer and smaller pores than in 1408.
In Hastelloy XR, some surface films were composed of oxide with enrichment of Cr and Mn, and oxide with only Cr enrichment beneath (fig. 6). Further, exfoliation of the former was also observed.
